gaps.item: Account menu and phone menu sheet inbox ('Since you were last here')
gaps.source: shell-me.md U25 Inbox, U26 account menu (acceptance 6); rebuild-v2 §2.6 + acceptance 10
gaps.evidence: /api/shell.inbox is an object {items,next,unread} but web/assets/ui.js accountItems()/menuSheet() test `if (d.inbox)` and print cap99(d.inbox)/fmt(d.inbox). Every learner, even with 0 unread, sees 'SINCE YOU WERE LAST HERE · NAN' and 'See all (NaN)' (seen on the desktop menu and the 390/360 menu sheet for the new and the seeded learner). Opening the menu also fires markSeen() -> POST /me/feed/seen -> refresh() on every open, which repaints and drops focus: after Enter on the user card document.activeElement stays BODY and ArrowDown/End/Home do nothing. With /api/shell patched to inbox:0 the same menu takes focus, End reaches 'Leave this device…', Esc returns to the user card.
gaps.build: In ui.js read the count with the existing unreadOf(d.inbox) everywhere (loadFeed, markSeen, accountItems, menuSheet) and use d.inbox.items as the first 3 rows (skip the extra GET); show the group only when unread > 0; call markSeen only when unread > 0 and do not repaint the open menu (refresh after close).

gaps.item: Me › Pace card (U7)
gaps.source: shell-me.md U7 'Me › Pace'; §3 override 32
gaps.evidence: server/api_profile.py summary() never adds pace: /api/me/summary.subjects.math keys are target, band, gains, coverage, domains, levers, habits. me.js PAINT.pace reads S.subjects.math.pace, so the card always shows 'Answer with the clock on to see where your minutes go.' although progress.pace(seeded learner) returns 6 skills with n>=5, quadrants and a forecast (1320 s of 2100).
gaps.build: In api_profile.summary set math['pace'] = progress.pace(learner) (skills, quadrants, forecast, guess, struck2) so the header line, quadrant chart, per-quadrant drills and the 'When you guess' line render.

gaps.item: A saved learner's a: code never reaches a d: device
gaps.source: shell-me.md U21 (acceptance 3; 'A saved learner's a: code is never shown or copyable again')
gaps.evidence: With a d: token of an email-saved learner: GET /api/me returns profile.id = the a: code, GET /api/today contains it, POST /api/transfer/redeem for a saved learner returns {credential:'d:…', learner:'a:ffff…03'}, and GET /api/link/{token} after approval returns learner:'a:…' next to the credential. Inside the 14-day swap window that a: code still signs in and mints new keys, so a shared-computer or transferred device keeps a way back after its token is revoked.
gaps.build: Strip the learner id from every response to a d: request (api_me profile.id, api_today, transfer redeem, link status, verify when the caller is not the a: holder); return only the credential. Add the s1 check that greps every endpoint body for the a: code.

gaps.item: Swap window: one device key per browser
gaps.source: shell-me.md U21 'The swap window' (acceptance 4)
gaps.evidence: A second browser holding a saved learner's a: code loaded /me/ once: GET /api/devices went from 3 to 12 rows, nine 'Chrome on Mac · moved to its own key Sep 29' (every parallel request on the page got its own X-Learner-Swap token). Settings › Devices lists all nine as separate live devices.
gaps.build: Make the swap idempotent: for the same a: code + User-Agent within a short window (e.g. 5 min) return the already-minted swap token instead of inserting a new devices row (or have UI.api hold other requests until the first swap header arrives); clean up duplicates.

gaps.item: Practice ranks show only board names, and board visibility applies
gaps.source: shell-me.md U29 (acceptance 3), R12, §3.1.5 progress.practice_rank / board visibility
gaps.evidence: server/api_profile.py _practice_rank builds top as r['handle'] or r['name']: /api/me/summary ranks.all.top listed another student's private name ('Secretname'); with that student's board set to 'anon' it still showed 'Secretname'; and GET /api/shared/{token} (no login, a parent link) also contains 'Secretname'.
gaps.build: In _practice_rank use handle or challenge.handle(learner) only, never learners.name; apply 'anon' -> handle and keep 'hidden' excluded; drop other learners' rows from the shared payload.

gaps.item: Notify me on this device (Web Push)
gaps.source: shell-me.md U18(b); §3 override 17 and 34; rebuild-v2 Settings §4.3
gaps.evidence: No server/push.py and no /api/push/* route (route list has none); /api/health has no push flag. settings.js paintPush returns early (`if (!(await health()).push) return`), so Settings › Study shows no 'Notify me on this device' row, and UI.notify.offer never fires. web/sw.js and db push_subs exist but nothing sends.
gaps.build: Build server/push.py: VAPID key pair in server/vapid.pem (ES256 via cryptography), GET /api/push/key, POST/PUT/DELETE /api/push/subscribe, POST /api/push/next (text from next.queue), the 5-minute scheduler at study_time − remind with quiet hours for extra nudges only, SATF_PUSH=off → 404, and health.push.

gaps.item: GET /api/health: version, mail, google (+client id), push
gaps.source: rebuild-v2 §3.1.5 'GET /api/health: version'; shell-me.md U19 (acceptance 8), U19b, §3 override 36
gaps.evidence: GET /api/health returns only {"ok":true,"forms":10} (server/app.py health()). mail.mode() exists but is not exposed, so: /signin/#email and Settings › Email offer the Send code form with SMTP off (the 'aren't switched on' text appears only after sending); signin.js shows Continue with Google only when health.google && health.google_client_id, so Google sign-in can never appear even with SATF_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID set; the report modal's device list has no App version.
gaps.build: Return {ok, forms, version (git short sha read once, 'dev'), mail: mail.mode(), google: bool, google_client_id when set, push: bool} from /api/health.

gaps.item: Run screens: between-parts pane and day rail (Start today chaining)
gaps.source: product.md G1 'The run (UI.run)', R40; shell-me.md U1 'Chaining'
gaps.evidence: UI.run.between and UI.run.rail exist in web/assets/ui.js but grep finds no caller in web/ (only palette.js calls UI.run.start). Started a run (label 'Start today · 6 parts · 55 min'), finished part 1 (cfg.run = today): the session summary shows 'Keep going · Same settings, new questions' with no .run-between pane, no 'Continue ↵ / Skip this part / Stop for now', no 'Next: {Up next title}' primary and no rail in the header.
gaps.build: In the practice session summary (and S6 report footer, S9 words run end) call UI.run.between(host, {title,right,total,minutes}) when cfg.run is today, else make 'Next: {first /api/next item}' the primary; show UI.run.rail in the session header while a run is on.

gaps.item: Today nav meta 'Done' follows the Plan day rule
gaps.source: rebuild-v2 §2.2 item 4 (Today meta), §2.12 UI.plan.doneOf; U1 'Day done'
gaps.evidence: Seeded learner with an active plan (0 of 5 tasks done, 8 of 45 min): the sidebar Today item reads 'Done' while the Now strip shows 'Study time 8 of 45 min' and Up next 'Plan · Warm-up · Today's plan · 5 tasks'. /api/shell.today.done is null and UI.plan.doneOf is never defined, so ui.js dayDone() falls back to questions >= per_session (30 >= 26).
gaps.build: Set shell.today.done from the plan part (plan.done >= plan.total, R41) on the server, or have dayDone() use d.plan.done/d.plan.total when present; keep the questions fallback only when there is no plan.

gaps.item: Quick sheet: Another on Enter
gaps.source: rebuild-v2 §2.7 Quick question step 4, acceptance 12
gaps.evidence: Press Q, answer with A then Enter (Check): the verdict shows 'Another Enter', but pressing Enter again leaves the same stem (stem before and after identical). Same with mouse: click B, click Check, then Enter: focus sits on option A and the stem does not change. Only N loads a new one.
gaps.build: In quick.js move focus to the Another button when the verdict shows (or let the delegate's Enter run next() whenever fb is set, even with an .opt focused, since the options are locked after Check).

gaps.item: Palette 'Download my data'
gaps.source: shell-me.md U24 Actions; rebuild-v2 §4.6
gaps.evidence: palette.js actionRows: { label: 'Download my data', run: () => go('/api/me/export') } navigates the browser to /api/me/export, which carries no X-Learner header: curl without the header → 400. Settings' own exportData() uses UI.api and works.
gaps.build: Run the same export as Settings (UI.api('/me/export') then save the JSON as sat-freshman-YYYY-MM-DD.json), e.g. expose it as UI.acct.exportData and call it from the palette.

gaps.item: Continue on your phone (account-menu row and palette command)
gaps.source: product.md G12 'Continue on your phone'
gaps.evidence: qr.js continueOnPhone() posts /api/pair, which was never built (U20 replaced it with /api/link). /api/shell.has.pair is false, so ui.js accountItems and palette.js hide the row and the command; the account menu lists no 'Continue on your phone'.
gaps.build: Rebase continueOnPhone on the U20 link flow (the laptop shows a QR of /pair/?r=…&go=<path>, the phone approves, the phone lands on go, with the same go whitelist) or add the /api/pair endpoints; then show the menu row and palette command.

gaps.item: Log a mistake › Bring many at once (up to 200 IDs)
gaps.source: shell-me.md U2 'Bring many at once' (acceptance 9); §3 override 30 'Bring your misses'
gaps.evidence: POST /api/mistakes/import → 405 (no route). No textarea/table UI: grep of web/ for 'many at once', 'Not in our set', 'mistakes/import' finds nothing; Me › Saved & in progress offers only 'Log a missed question'.
gaps.build: Server: POST /api/mistakes/import {ids ≤ 200} → {rows:[{id,template,topic,matched}], added}, 5 a day. UI (quick sheet and Me › Saved 'Bring your misses'): textarea, result table ID · skill · type · Matched/Not in our set with a skill select for unmatched, footer split line, 'Add n to my mistakes' and 'Practise all · 2 each'.

gaps.item: Log a mistake › A whole test (Bluebook grids) follow-up
gaps.source: shell-me.md U2 'Log a mistake → a whole test' (acceptance 6)
gaps.evidence: POST /api/outside/misses → 405 and /api/shell.has.outside is false, so quick.js follow() takes its ponytail path: a plain topics drill (2 per skill, source 'outside'). The misses are not stored on the outside score, the set is not drawn from the skill's missed-then-never-met types, and it does not become Up next item 1.
gaps.build: Build POST /api/outside/misses {score_id, misses:[{module,n,topic,letter?}]} → {set}: store misses JSON on outside_scores and create the 'Bluebook follow-up' set with segments (missed types first, then never met), surfaced by next.queue.

gaps.item: Score trend looks forward (projection cone, pace line, what changed)
gaps.source: shell-me.md U9; §3 override 24
gaps.evidence: api_profile.summary's score is {latest, best, points} only; me.js sets o.projection only when S.score.projection !== undefined and o.gaps only when S.score.gaps exist, so Me's trend never draws a cone, never prints 'Three modules over three weeks start a projection.' (seeded learner with 1 sitting shows neither) and has no 'what changed' gaps. estimate.projection exists (api_tests uses it).
gaps.build: Add score.projection = estimate.projection(learner, exam_date) (null when too few sittings), score.pace (plan start → target line) and score.gaps (per adjacent pair: questions, minutes, fixes, skills moved, band change) to the summary.

gaps.item: Shared progress view (/share/?t=)
gaps.source: rebuild-v2 §6; shell-me.md §3 override 37
gaps.evidence: Opened a live link: the Activity card stays on its skeleton forever (the /api/shared payload has no activity/days); the Snapshot row prints a literal 'null' ('360–560 | null | Module · Sep 29'); the H1 is 'SAT progress' with 'Shared by the student' although the learner's name is Dana (payload has no name); no Words card although the payload carries words.
gaps.build: Server: add the student's name and activity days (26 weeks) to GET /api/shared/{token}. me.js read-only mode: render '{name}'s SAT progress · Shared by {name}', paint the heatmap from the shared days, drop the Report slot instead of printing null, and add the Words card from words.me_stats.

gaps.item: Every number opens its working (lever popovers on Me)
gaps.source: shell-me.md U13 (acceptance 2), U10 outcome strip 'each a button opening its lever'; product.md G6
gaps.evidence: On /me/ only 3 fact keys exist (streak, minutes:today, minutes:week). ANSWERED, FIRST-TRY ACCURACY and TESTS tiles are plain links (Enter navigates), the outcome strip figures, skill mastery bars, the band, ranks and readiness have no data-fact, although GET /api/levers serves skill:circles, band, points, readiness, rank:… .
gaps.build: Add data-fact to every Me figure: tiles (answered, accuracy:all:7, tests, mistakes fixed), outcome strip (band/since start, points, fixes held), each skill's mastery bar (skill:<topic>), the band, each rank line (rank:…), readiness; keep the link as a 'See' action inside the popover.

gaps.item: Week sheet opens on the first clean load of the week, on any section root
gaps.source: shell-me.md U14 'The sheet', U25 acceptance 4-5
gaps.evidence: web/me/week.js (UI.week) is loaded only by web/me/index.html. Fresh device for the seeded learner: '/' and '/practice/' open no sheet and leave satf.week.shown unset; only '/me/' opens 'Your week, Sep 28 – Oct 4'.
gaps.build: Load week.js lazily from ui.js autoSheets (UI.need('week')) on every section root, so the week sheet (with welcome-back merged in) opens on the first clean load of the week wherever it happens.

gaps.item: Your week: receipts, suggestions and Start the first
gaps.source: shell-me.md U14
gaps.evidence: GET /api/me/week receipts = {answered, right, accuracy, minutes, fixed, new_mistakes} only; the sheet shows '40 questions · 62% right on the first try · 32m'. Missing: accuracy change, minutes against the plan, check-ins passed/relapsed, skills that moved up a word, the habit that fell most, the estimate change. 4 suggestions (no pass_checks or habit_cap), none priced ('≈ 12 pts'); the sheet ends 'Not now · Save my goals' with no 'Start the first' pill and no custom goal.
gaps.build: Server: complete the receipts and the five suggestion kinds with pts from estimate.gains and a 'why' each. Sheet: add 'Start the first' (runs the first goal's drill) and a custom goal row (kind + number).

gaps.item: Me empty states for a 0-answer learner
gaps.source: product.md G12 'Empty states' and R55
gaps.evidence: New learner on /me/: Skills and Test-day readiness offer 'Today's set · 10', Recent activity 'Start today's set · 10', Score trend 'Start a module'; none shows a sample row. grep: me.js never calls UI.empty (only results/page.js and review/review.js do), and 'Start with 8' appears nowhere in web/me.

gaps.item: Practice rank movement since last week

gaps.item: Me H1 and board line for an unnamed learner
gaps.source: rebuild-v2 §3 acceptance 23 ('The H1 is Student XXXX'); U29 'On boards: Student 4F2A · Choose a board name'

gaps.item: 'Studying since' is the first attempt

gaps.item: Diagnostic confirmation email carries the sign-in code
gaps.source: rebuild-v2 §1 'The diagnostic sign-up is the same account', §3.1.5 mail.py

gaps.build: Mint a login code in signup and pass it to mail.send; add UI.otp boxes on the 'Check your email' step that POST /api/account/verify {code}.
